title: Screenshots of all 14 themes
lead: Compare the public Web app using the same 60-second clip paused near 15 seconds. The display varies with viewport size, media, playback position, and supported features. Scores and player information in the Sports theme are sample data.

themes.label: Neon
themes.description: Adds color and border styling to the standard layout.

themes.label: Glass
themes.description: Uses a translucent control bar in the standard layout.

themes.label: Sunset
themes.description: Adds a warm color palette to the standard layout.

themes.label: Bold
themes.description: Enlarges text and controls in the standard layout.

themes.label: Mono
themes.description: Styles the standard layout mainly in white, black, and gray.

themes.label: Live (DVR)
themes.description: Adds live-position, rewind, and wall-clock displays.

themes.label: Sports
themes.description: Overlays sample scores and player information.

themes.label: Binge
themes.description: Adds intro skipping and next-video controls.

themes.label: Cinema
themes.description: Uses a central play control and a slim control bar.

themes.label: Compact
themes.description: Uses a small, single-row control bar.

themes.label: Premiere
themes.description: Uses a title, description, and full-width seek bar.

themes.label: Creator
themes.description: Places one row of controls below a full-width seek bar.

themes.label: Studio
themes.description: Places the seek bar between time labels.
